prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1141; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep this to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. We'll keep identifying details out of the transcript. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was on the highway in Houston, Texas, during the afternoon commute. Traffic was moving but slowly, maybe thirty or forty miles an hour.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes to the left because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, saw a gap, and started to move over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?
A: Yes, I'm pretty sure I did. I had it on for a few seconds before I moved.

Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle in the lane I was moving into came up on my side much faster than I expected. I think they were trying to get around the car ahead of them. We sideswiped each other. My car spun a little and the driver's side took most of the damage.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: Only briefly. They pulled over onto the shoulder, and we exchanged insurance information.

Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my hand out to brace myself against the steering wheel and the airbag went off. My left wrist hit hard. The doctor at the emergency room said it's fractured, and I'm going to be in a cast for several weeks and then likely some physical therapy.

Q: Are you receiving treatment now?
A: Yes, I'm seeing an orthopedic specialist, and I have a follow-up scheduled.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I didn't see that other car until it was already on top of me.
